name: 8085 Exchange Memory
desc: This program exchanges the contents of two memory locations.

files.sketch.ino:
;Write an ALP to exchange the contents of the memory
; location 8000H to 8003H.

ORG 0000H       ; Program begins at code memory 0000H

LDA 8000H       ; Load the contents of 8000H into Accumulator (A)
MOV B, A        ; Save the contents of A into Register B
LDA 8003H       ; Load the contents of 8003H into Accumulator (A)
STA 8000H       ; Store the contents of A into 8000H
MOV A, B        ; Move the temporary value from B back to Accumulator (A)
STA 8003H       ; Store the contents of A into 8003H

HLT             ; Halt the program Execution

; --- Data Segment Definitions ---
ORG 8000H       ; Force assembler to jump to memory address 8000H
DB 42H          ; Define byte at 8000H (Decimal 66 or Hex 42H)

ORG 8003H       ; Force assembler to jump to memory address 8003H
DB 24H          ; Define byte at 8003H (Decimal 36 or Hex 24H)
